discont.description: float, optional Maximum discontinuity between values, default is ``period/2``. Values below ``period/2`` are treated as if they were ``period/2``. To have an effect different from the default, `discont` should be larger than ``period/2``.
constraints: Values below 'period/2' are treated as if they were 'period/2'
'discont' should be larger than 'period/2' to have an effect different from the default

axis.description: int, optional Axis along which unwrap will operate, default is the last axis.

period.description: float, optional Size of the range over which the input wraps. By default, it is ``2 pi``.
constraints: 'discont' should be larger than 'period/2' to have an effect different from the default
'discont' should be larger than 'period/2' to have an effect different from the default
